Seven genre engines differ by arrangement/synthesis, not only color
Drum & bass uses broken kicks, rather than the trance four-on-floor
House has swing and harmonic stabs while psy has gated rolling bass
A musical boost overrides the breakdown with an actual drop arrangement
Auto VJ evolves through multiple patterns on the bar clock
Pattern transitions crossfade rather than hard-jump
Calm and fixed-VJ modes disable pattern morphing
Flash accents require explicit opt-in, playback and non-calm mode
Flash beat windows are separated by two beats, even at maximum genre tempo
Spectrum bands are real bounded averages and silence is zero
Unknown genre selection safely returns a driver signature
